notes.title: Devlog #008 - Roadmap
notes.content:
Hi !
First of all I'd like to express my gratitude to all of you who have purchased or wishlisted THNT. Your support means the world and it's what keeps me motivated to continue creating and improving the game.

So .. what is next ? Here is the content, features and improvements you can expect in the coming months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443226/f30626a8e2f000a879b4850cf8e61ecaa58a4558.png[/img]

[b]Episodes 2 & 3[/b]
New episodes are already in the works! No spoilers for now :)

[b]Survival mode[/b]
To offer more 'bang for the buck' and to shorten the wait for the new episodes, there will be a Survival mode in the next content update ! In this mode, you'll face off against waves of enemies that become increasingly difficult as you progress and get better upgrades and weapons. There will also be a leaderboard after the full release.

[b]Weapon customization[/b]
The usual. Change the barrel, replace the foregrip, attach scope and laser pointer to a sword ...

[b]Feedback[/b]
Do you like the game so far or are you in 'WTF is this ****' camp ? I'd like to hear your thoughts, suggestions, OP builds or ways you managed to break the game.

Stay tuned for the next devlog !

notes.title: Devlog #006 - Polishing, more polishing & release preparations
notes.content:
Hi!
Back again with another THNT devlog. The last few months were mostly filled with performance optimization and general polish, so there was nothing 'flashy' to share: until now !

[h2]Early Access release[/h2]
At last, the date has been set. Early access containing the first episode will hit the virtual shelves early next year !

[h2]Hub[/h2]
Hub serves as a home base. Here you can rest, craft new items and customize your character before returning to action.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443226/b943a5c05d26205a61d3ec6ef17dd1e40bc36334.png[/img]

[h2]Character customization[/h2]
Another thing that was finalized is character customization. You will find a multitude of upgrades and abilities to create the character that suits your playstyle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443226/34bb33a0f0b279fa26c5317552c9b0c358776bf4.png[/img]

[h2]Multiple item functions[/h2]
Many items in THNT can be used in more than one way. For example, the blaster can fire single shots or charge and fire multiple projectiles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443226/6151e2f9645f94b10784dea5c666b21625abc889.gif[/img]

Stay awesome & stay tuned !

notes.title: Devlog #005 - UI, Gibbage & Environment
notes.content:
Hi!
Another THNT devlog is here.

[h2]Improved gibbage[/h2]
Enemies can now be blown up or torn to pieces even fancier. Losing body parts impairs their combat ability and influences behavior.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443226/20b09a8e6ea0e7ce461c1e0b953d8c804c50a462.gif[/img]

[h2]New inventory UI[/h2]
Inventory management has become a little more pleasant with the new UI. Player can now get a closer look at the attributes and functions of each item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443226/0f287132d1dfef04c58f6ad2749af54fd0d69081.png[/img]

[h2]Environment building[/h2]
Work on all kinds of environments is progressing steadily.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443226/e0a8ad7c2995973dae632d7fca8b8cd5dfecd629.png[/img]

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Devlog #004 - Dash, EMP & optimization
notes.content:
Hi there !
We are back after a short break with another devlog.

[h2]Dash[/h2]
Movement got a little bit more polish and a new feature - dash. Player can now move out of (or into) danger with more style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443226/2a45849f78a2756134d25d08114035aebd6f4b70.gif[/img]

[h2]EMP[/h2]
EMP rockets are now part of player's arsenal. They quickly deplete shields and restrict movement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443226/43a7080125d254313e9c54d5b3a6da234e46fe52.gif[/img]

There have also been multiple minor improvements like new weapon attachments, enemy variants and performance tweaks.

Stay tuned for the next devlog !

notes.title: Devlog #003 - Enemy variants & weapon attachments
notes.content:
Hi !
Latest devlog is here.

[h2]New weapon attachments[/h2]
Tuning up your arsenal and weapon customization will be a big part of the THNT experience. This week we added weapon attachments that will enable player to stun, confuse or vaporize the enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443226/1d12c0a53e85f54249a2a0ca695212b35499b7c9.gif[/img]

[h2]Enemy variants[/h2]
Multiple assault variants have been added. They are fast and have strong frontal armor. Engaging them head on is possible, although they are more vulnerable when flanked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443226/d5ea053b719e062eaf8b5b463ab6b0a0db014517.gif[/img]

See you next time !

notes.title: Devlog #001 - Items, Inventory, Demo
notes.content:
Hi !
Welcome to the first installment of THNT devlog. Lets jump right into it ...

[h2]Items & player inventory[/h2]
This week was mostly about adding new items and balancing the inventory gameplay. Current system allows the player to carry anything, only limit is the sum weight of all the stuff in the inventory.

New / updated items:
[list]
[*] flare
[*] HE grenade
[*] energy charger
[*] improved medkit
[/list]
[h2]Flares[/h2]
There are many dark places in THNT, navigating them should be a bit easier now
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443226/8961b89ce915a58e997a35b2fc420c50192d726a.gif[/img]

[h2]Demo[/h2]
Free demo is in the works, it should be available for download in 5-6 weeks.

Devlog #002 coming next week. Until then, stay awesome !
